comments.author: tonic5
comments.why: Explains how combined fridge/freezer units work and why layout matters.
comments.text: Combined fridge/freezer units use a heat pump to get the freezer really cold and residual cold air is cycled into the fridge. So having the freezer on bottom is not the optimal design, maybe because cold air is dense and will fall taking more active effort to distribute it. Source: [VIDEO]
